mapper.insert: INSERT INTO woorido.meetings ( id, challenge_id, title, description, location, location_detail, agenda, scheduled_at, meeting_date, status, beneficiary_id, benefit_amount, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{challengeId}, #{title}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{location,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{locationDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{agenda,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{scheduledAt}, #{scheduledAt}, #{status}, #{beneficiaryId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{benefitAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.id as MEETING_ID, m.challenge_id as CHALLENGE_ID, m.title as TITLE, m.description as DESCRIPTION, m.status as STATUS, m.scheduled_at as SCHEDULED_AT, m.location as LOCATION, m.location_detail as LOCATION_DETAIL, m.agenda as AGENDA, m.benefit_amount as BENEFIT_AMOUNT, m.created_at as CREATED_AT, m.beneficiary_id as BENEFICIARY_ID, (SELECT u.nickname FROM woorido.users u WHERE u.id = m.beneficiary_id) as BENEFICIARY_NICKNAME, m.created_by as CREATOR_ID, (SELECT u.nickname FROM woorido.users u JOIN woorido.challenge_members cm ON u.id = cm.user_id WHERE cm.id = m.created_by) as CREATOR_NICKNAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM woorido.meeting_votes mv JOIN woorido.meeting_vote_records mvr ON mv.id = mvr.meeting_vote_id WHERE mv.meeting_id = m.id AND mvr.choice = 'AGREE') as CONFIRMED_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM woorido.meeting_votes mv JOIN woorido.meeting_vote_records mvr ON mv.id = mvr.meeting_vote_id WHERE mv.meeting_id = m.id AND mvr.choice = 'DISAGREE') as DECLINED_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM woorido.meeting_votes mv JOIN woorido.meeting_vote_records mvr ON mv.id = mvr.meeting_vote_id WHERE mv.meeting_id = m.id AND mvr.choice IS NULL) as PENDING_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM woorido.challenge_members cm WHERE cm.challenge_id = m.challenge_id AND cm.privilege_status = 'ACTIVE') as TOTAL_MEMBERS FROM woorido.meetings m WHERE m.id = #{meetingId}
mapper.update: UPDATE woorido.meetings SET title = #{title}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, location = #{location,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, location_detail = #{locationDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, agenda = #{agenda,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}, meeting_date = #{scheduledAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE woorido.meetings SET status = 'COMPLETED', notes = #{notes,jdbcType=CLOB}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
